metadata.description: Ask GPT for a second opinion: interpretation-check before work and adversarial code review before handoff. Consent-first, best-effort secret redaction, optional enforcement hook.

plugins.name: ask-gpt
plugins.description: Get an independent second opinion from GPT (your own OpenAI key): check your plan against the request BEFORE coding (--interpret), and adversarially review the diff BEFORE handoff. Privacy-first: sensitive files excluded, secrets redacted (best-effort), --dry-run preview, first-run consent. Optional Stop hook for deterministic enforcement.
